11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager asked to speak at a gathering imagines every possible disaster, including a falling coconut.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been asked to speak at a village gathering. (subject.He/She) has prepared carefully, but now (subject.his/her) imagination is producing an extraordinary number of possible disasters. What if (subject.he/she) forgets everything? What if everyone laughs? What if a coconut falls from a tree at precisely the wrong moment?

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) listens patiently. (subject) forgets a sentence, starts again, and eventually completes the speech. "That wasn't so bad," says (friend). "No," admits (subject). "Although there weren't any coconuts."

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) checks the gathering place, arranges (subject.his/her) notes, and chooses a spot away from the coconut trees. The speech goes reasonably well. Halfway through, a bird interrupts with an enormous squawk. Everyone laughs, including (subject).
